# llms.txt

## Repository Summary
- Workshop: The Architecture of Intent
- Runtime: 120 minutes
- Core Method: C.L.E.A.R.+ with Diagnose-Isolate-Constrain
- Delivery Mode: facilitator coaching with active participant example harvesting

## Runtime Map (120 Minutes Total)
- 00:00-00:15 | Opening Ritual and Baseline
- 00:15-00:35 | Human Delegation Lab
- 00:35-00:50 | Assumption Gap and C.L.E.A.R.+ Engine
- 00:50-01:00 | Break and Informal Table Chat
- 01:00-01:25 | Prompt Makeover Studio
- 01:25-01:50 | Live Iteration Crucible
- 01:50-02:00 | Highlight Session and Commitments

## Structured Coaching Schema
Per slide metadata fields:
- data-speaker-time
- data-speaker-say
- data-speaker-do
- data-speaker-ask
- data-speaker-adapt
- data-speaker-ritual

Overlay render fields:
- TIME
- SAY
- DO
- ASK
- CAPTURE and ADAPT
- FACILITATION RITUAL / PRO-TIP

## Facilitation Technique Embedding
- Opening ritual uses Serial Position Effect and low-friction check-in.
- Segments 2, 5, and 6 include visible progress tracking ticks on board.
- Segments 5 and 6 replace generic examples with participant-owned cases.
- Final segment uses Peak-End Rule with one big win + commitment round-robin.

## Multi-Angle Framing Case Set
- Tree Climbing scenario: role + audience + constraint shifts.
- Interpersonal conflict resolution: tone + de-escalation + ownership shifts.
- Shared responsibility handoff: accountability language without blame.
- Segment usage:
	- Segment 2: run blind execution and C.L.E.A.R.+ comparison on all three frames.
	- Segment 3: deconstruct assumption gaps with C.L.E.A.R.+ field-by-field analysis.
	- Segments 5 and 6: reuse harvested versions for makeover and live iteration.

## Presenter View Isolation Rules
- Public projection view shows only slide content.
- Coaching overlay remains hidden until S key toggle.
- Escape closes overlay.
- Key handling ignores input, textarea, select, and contenteditable targets.

## Synchronization Contract
index.html and script.md must remain 1:1 on:
- segment timestamps
- SAY lines
- DO actions
- ASK prompts
- CAPTURE and ADAPT behavior
- FACILITATION RITUAL / PRO-TIP cues

- [index.html](index.html): slide deck and presenter coaching overlay
- [script.md](script.md): facilitator script aligned to slide metadata
- [README.md](README.md): implementation and runtime notes
